host_validation: The unchanged Source validator calls validNeighborhoodSpans. The overlay enforces known mode, finite nonnegative radius, radius <= certified maximum distance, all-zero extension lanes in mode 0, and existing sample/range and triangle validity checks.
fingerprint: The unchanged exact-base Source fingerprint hashes femBodyContactNeighborhoodRanges.size() * sizeof(NMNumiHumanFEMBodyContactNeighborhoodRangeGPU). With the ABI-15 type, all 32 bytes of each row are fingerprinted.
proof: For a complete caller-supplied body-local triangle inventory, producer includes every face with rest distance <= d_min + 2(R+e)+g. The GPU selector rejects query points farther than R+e from stored rest point; e is 32 float epsilons scaled by max(1, max(abs(rest xyz))+R), and g covers registered triangle coordinate arithmetic. By triangle inequality, an omitted face cannot beat the rest-nearest face anywhere in that guarded motion ball. Capacity overflow rejects rather than truncates.
limits: Completeness is conditional on complete declared source inventory and query remaining in the stored body-local envelope. Mode-0 manual banks retain legacy behavior but carry no completeness guarantee. This does not establish global anatomical coverage, full-scene collision, integrated runtime behavior, or natural motion qualification.
